description: This file defines the ParamConversionEnhancer class, which implements route parameter conversion handling and exception management within Drupal's routing system.

classes.name: Drupal\Core\Routing\Enhancer\ParamConversionEnhancer
classes.description: Provides a route enhancer that handles parameter conversion and exception handling for Drupal routing.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ParamConversionEnhancer with a parameter converter manager.

methods.name: enhance
methods.description: Performs parameter conversion on route defaults once per request.

methods.name: copyRawVariables
methods.description: Creates a backup of raw route variables to prevent them from being overwritten during conversion.

methods.name: onException
methods.description: Handles conversion exceptions by converting them into 404 Not Found HTTP exceptions.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Registers the onException method to handle kernel exception events.
